subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Base composition and DNA melting temperature
stimulus.description: Four double-stranded DNA samples of equal length were heated. The temperature at which half of each sample became single-stranded was recorded.
stimulus.note: All samples were tested at the same pH and salt concentration.

question: Analyse the relationship between G+C content and melting temperature, and explain the molecular basis of the pattern.
markscheme: Melting temperature increases as G+C content increases.
Sample P has the lowest G+C content and lowest melting temperature, while S has the highest values.
Guanine pairs with cytosine by complementary base pairing.
G-C base pairs form three hydrogen bonds whereas A-T base pairs form two.
A DNA sample with more G-C pairs therefore requires more thermal energy to separate its strands.
markschemeJa: G+C含量が増えるほどDNAの融解温度は上昇している。
PはG+C含量と融解温度が最も低く、Sは両方とも最も高い。
グアニンとシトシンは相補的塩基対を形成する。
G-C塩基対は3本、A-T塩基対は2本の水素結合を形成する。
G-C塩基対が多いDNAほど、2本鎖を分離するためにより多くの熱エネルギーが必要になる。
modelAnswer: The melting temperature rises from 73 °C at 28% G+C to 90 °C at 68% G+C, showing a positive relationship. G-C base pairs form three hydrogen bonds, whereas A-T pairs form two. DNA with a greater proportion of G-C pairs therefore needs more thermal energy to disrupt enough hydrogen bonds for the strands to separate.
modelAnswerJa: G+C含量が28%から68%へ増えると融解温度は73 °Cから90 °Cへ上昇しており、正の関係があります。G-C塩基対は3本、A-T塩基対は2本の水素結合を形成するため、G-Cの割合が高いDNAほど2本鎖を分離するのに多くの熱エネルギーが必要です。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Mating success among three island populations
stimulus.description: Researchers paired adults from three geographically separated populations. The percentage of pairings that produced fertile offspring is shown.
stimulus.note: All pairings were carried out under the same laboratory conditions.

question: Using the data, deduce which populations show the strongest evidence of reproductive isolation and explain how reproductive isolation can contribute to speciation.
markscheme: X and Z show strong reproductive isolation because only 18% of their pairings produced fertile offspring.
Y and Z also show strong isolation, with only 21% successful fertile offspring.
X and Y show substantially greater reproductive compatibility than either population does with Z.
Reduced successful interbreeding reduces gene flow between populations.
With restricted gene flow, populations can accumulate genetic differences independently and may become separate species.
markschemeJa: XとZは繁殖可能な子孫を生じた組み合わせが18%しかなく、生殖隔離の強い証拠を示す。
YとZも21%しか成功しておらず、強い隔離を示す。
XとYは、Zを含む組み合わせよりかなり高い生殖的適合性を示す。
交配成功率が低下すると集団間の遺伝子流動が減少する。
遺伝子流動が制限されると各集団が独立に遺伝的差異を蓄積し、別種へ分化する可能性がある。
modelAnswer: Population Z is most strongly isolated from X and Y. Only 18% of X × Z and 21% of Y × Z pairings produced fertile offspring, compared with 76% for X × Y. Reproductive isolation reduces gene flow, allowing separated populations to accumulate genetic differences independently. Continued divergence can eventually result in speciation.
modelAnswerJa: Z集団はX・Yの両方から最も強く隔離されています。X×Zは18%、Y×Zは21%しか繁殖可能な子孫を生じませんが、X×Yでは76%です。生殖隔離により遺伝子流動が減少すると、集団は独立に遺伝的差異を蓄積し、最終的に種分化につながることがあります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Energy yield and water associated with stored fuels
stimulus.description: A researcher compared two storage compounds in animal tissue.
columns: Associated water in storage (g water per g compound)
stimulus.note: Values are approximate means for the samples studied.

question: Analyse why triglycerides are well suited to long-term energy storage compared with glycogen.
markscheme: Triglyceride releases more than twice as much energy per gram as glycogen in the data.
Triglyceride is stored with much less associated water than glycogen.
Lipids contain many energy-rich carbon-hydrogen bonds that can be oxidized during respiration.
Their hydrophobic nature allows storage with little water.
These properties make triglyceride storage more compact for a given amount of stored energy.
markschemeJa: データではトリグリセリドはグリコーゲンの2倍以上のエネルギーを1 gあたり放出する。
トリグリセリドはグリコーゲンよりはるかに少ない水しか伴わずに貯蔵される。
脂質には呼吸で酸化できるエネルギーに富む炭素-水素結合が多い。
疎水性であるため大量の水を伴わずに貯蔵できる。
これらの性質により、同じ量のエネルギーをよりコンパクトに蓄えられる。
modelAnswer: Triglycerides provide about 38 kJ g⁻¹ compared with 17 kJ g⁻¹ for glycogen and are stored with very little associated water. Their many carbon-hydrogen bonds provide a high energy yield, while their hydrophobicity allows compact storage. This makes triglycerides particularly effective for long-term energy reserves.
modelAnswerJa: トリグリセリドは約38 kJ g⁻¹で、グリコーゲンの17 kJ g⁻¹より高いエネルギーをもち、しかもほとんど水を伴わずに貯蔵されます。炭素-水素結合が多く高いエネルギー収量をもち、疎水性なのでコンパクトに蓄えられるため、長期エネルギー貯蔵に適しています。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Amino-acid substitution and receptor binding
stimulus.description: A receptor protein was produced with one amino-acid substitution at a time. Binding to its ligand was measured relative to the normal protein.
stimulus.note: All proteins were produced and measured under the same conditions.

question: Analyse the results and explain how an amino-acid substitution can alter protein function.
markscheme: Variant 2 has the greatest reduction in ligand binding, to 27% of normal.
Variant 1 retains most binding activity, at 92% of normal.
Amino-acid side chains differ in chemical properties such as charge and polarity.
Changing a side chain can alter interactions that determine protein folding and three-dimensional shape.
If the shape or chemical properties of a binding site change, ligand binding and therefore protein function can decrease.
markschemeJa: Variant 2はリガンド結合が正常の27%まで低下し、最も大きな影響を受けている。
Variant 1は正常の92%で、結合能の大部分を維持している。
アミノ酸の側鎖は電荷や極性などの化学的性質が異なる。
側鎖が変わるとタンパク質の折りたたみや立体構造を決める相互作用が変化することがある。
結合部位の形や化学的性質が変化すると、リガンド結合が低下しタンパク質機能も低下しうる。
modelAnswer: The non-polar-to-charged substitution caused the largest loss of binding, reducing activity to 27%, whereas the non-polar-to-non-polar substitution retained 92%. Side chains differ in charge and polarity, so substitutions can change the interactions that stabilize folding. A changed three-dimensional structure or binding-site chemistry can reduce ligand binding and alter protein function.
modelAnswerJa: 非極性から荷電アミノ酸への置換では結合能が27%まで低下し、非極性同士の置換では92%が保たれています。側鎖の電荷や極性が変わると折りたたみを安定化する相互作用が変化し、結合部位の形や化学的性質が変わって機能が低下することがあります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Mean number of selected organelles in three cell types
stimulus.description: Electron micrographs were used to estimate organelle abundance in equal areas of cytoplasm.
stimulus.note: Values are means from multiple micrographs.

question: Analyse how organelle abundance relates to the specialized functions of the muscle cell and plasma cell.
markscheme: The muscle cell has the greatest mitochondrial abundance in the data.
A high mitochondrial abundance supports high ATP demand associated with repeated contraction.
The plasma cell has many more rough ER profiles than the other cells.
Rough ER supports synthesis of proteins destined for secretion, including antibodies.
The plasma cell also has many secretory vesicles, consistent with packaging and release of large quantities of antibody.
markschemeJa: 筋細胞はデータ中でミトコンドリアが最も多い。
多くのミトコンドリアは繰り返す収縮に必要な高いATP需要を支える。
形質細胞は他の細胞より粗面小胞体が非常に多い。
粗面小胞体は抗体など分泌されるタンパク質の合成を支える。
形質細胞には分泌小胞も多く、大量の抗体を包装・放出する機能と一致する。
modelAnswer: The muscle cell contains the most mitochondria, consistent with the high ATP demand of contraction. In contrast, the plasma cell has abundant rough ER and many secretory vesicles. Rough ER supports synthesis of secreted proteins, and vesicles transport and release them, matching the plasma cell's role in producing large quantities of antibody.
modelAnswerJa: 筋細胞には最も多くのミトコンドリアがあり、収縮に必要な高いATP需要と一致します。一方、形質細胞には粗面小胞体と分泌小胞が多く、分泌タンパク質である抗体を大量に合成し、運搬・放出する機能と一致します。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Features of three epithelial cell types
stimulus.description: Selected structural features were measured for cells from different tissues.

question: Using the data, deduce how structural specialization supports the functions of the three cell types.
markscheme: The intestinal cell has the largest relative apical surface area, increasing membrane area for nutrient absorption.
The kidney tubule cell has high surface area and the highest mitochondrial density.
High mitochondrial density can support ATP production for active transport during ion reabsorption.
The alveolar cell has a comparatively low mitochondrial density and is specialized for passive gas diffusion rather than high rates of active transport.
Different cell types therefore have structures and organelle abundance suited to their particular functions.
markschemeJa: 小腸吸収細胞は相対的な頂端表面積が最も大きく、栄養吸収に使える膜面積を増やしている。
腎尿細管細胞は表面積が大きく、ミトコンドリア密度が最も高い。
高いミトコンドリア密度は、イオン再吸収の能動輸送に必要なATP産生を支える。
肺胞細胞はミトコンドリア密度が比較的低く、高い能動輸送より受動的なガス拡散に特化している。
したがって異なる細胞型は、それぞれの機能に適した構造とオルガネラ量をもつ。
modelAnswer: Intestinal absorptive cells have the greatest apical surface area, supporting rapid nutrient uptake. Kidney tubule cells combine a large surface area with the highest mitochondrial density, which can provide ATP for active ion transport. Alveolar cells require efficient passive diffusion rather than intensive active transport. The contrasting structures illustrate how specialized cells are adapted to different functions.
modelAnswerJa: 小腸吸収細胞は大きな頂端表面積をもち、栄養の取り込みを支えます。腎尿細管細胞は大きな表面積と高いミトコンドリア密度をもち、能動的なイオン輸送に必要なATPを供給できます。肺胞細胞は主に受動拡散を行います。この違いは細胞の特殊化が機能に適応していることを示します。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Oxygen uptake by germinating seeds
stimulus.description: Equal masses of germinating seeds were placed in respirometers at different temperatures. Oxygen uptake was measured for 20 minutes.
stimulus.note: Carbon dioxide was absorbed inside each respirometer.

question: Analyse the effect of temperature on oxygen uptake and explain the pattern in terms of cellular respiration.
markscheme: Oxygen uptake increases from 10 °C to a maximum measured value at 40 °C.
The rate rises from 0.7 to 3.1 cm³ g⁻¹ h⁻¹ between 10 °C and 40 °C.
Oxygen uptake decreases strongly at 50 °C.
Cellular respiration includes enzyme-controlled reactions whose rates generally increase with temperature up to an optimum.
At excessive temperature, enzyme structure and cell function can be disrupted, reducing respiration and oxygen consumption.
markschemeJa: 酸素吸収量は10 °Cから増加し、測定値では40 °Cで最大となる。
10 °Cから40 °Cで0.7から3.1 cm³ g⁻¹ h⁻¹へ増加している。
50 °Cでは酸素吸収量が大きく低下する。
細胞呼吸には酵素により制御される反応が含まれ、最適温度までは一般に温度上昇とともに反応速度が上がる。
高すぎる温度では酵素構造や細胞機能が損なわれ、呼吸と酸素消費が低下する。
modelAnswer: Oxygen uptake rises from 0.7 at 10 °C to 3.1 cm³ g⁻¹ h⁻¹ at 40 °C, then falls to 1.2 at 50 °C. Enzyme-controlled reactions of respiration speed up as temperature rises toward an optimum. At excessive temperatures, disruption of enzymes and cellular structures lowers the rate of respiration.
modelAnswerJa: 酸素吸収量は10 °Cの0.7から40 °Cの3.1まで増え、50 °Cでは1.2へ低下します。呼吸の酵素反応は最適温度までは温度上昇で速くなりますが、高温では酵素や細胞構造が損なわれて呼吸速度が低下します。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Axon properties and conduction velocity
stimulus.description: Conduction velocity was measured in three types of axon.
stimulus.note: Measurements were made at the same temperature.

question: Analyse how axon diameter and myelination affect conduction velocity, and explain one mechanism that accounts for the data.
markscheme: The larger unmyelinated axon Q conducts faster than the smaller unmyelinated axon P.
At the same diameter, the myelinated axon R conducts much faster than unmyelinated Q.
Increasing axon diameter reduces internal resistance to ion movement and can increase conduction speed.
Myelin electrically insulates much of the axon membrane.
In myelinated axons, action potentials are regenerated mainly at nodes, allowing rapid saltatory conduction between nodes.
markschemeJa: 太い無髄軸索Qは細い無髄軸索Pより伝導速度が速い。
同じ直径では、有髄軸索Rは無髄軸索Qよりはるかに速い。
軸索径が大きいと内部抵抗が小さくなり、伝導速度を高められる。
髄鞘は軸索膜の多くを電気的に絶縁する。
有髄軸索では活動電位が主に節で再生され、節から節へ跳躍的に伝導するため速くなる。
modelAnswer: Axon Q is wider than P and conducts faster, while R and Q have the same diameter but R is far faster because it is myelinated. A larger diameter reduces internal resistance. Myelin insulates the membrane so depolarization spreads rapidly between nodes, where action potentials are regenerated. This saltatory conduction greatly increases speed.
modelAnswerJa: QはPより太く伝導速度が速く、同じ直径のQとRでは有髄のRが大幅に速くなっています。太い軸索は内部抵抗が小さく、髄鞘は膜を絶縁して脱分極を節間で速く広げます。活動電位が節で再生される跳躍伝導により高速化します。

subject: Biology SL
unit: C4.2 Transfers of energy and matter
primaryUnit: C4.2 Transfers of energy and matter
requiredUnits: C4.2 Transfers of energy and matter

stimulus.title: Energy stored as new biomass
stimulus.description: Energy stored in new biomass was estimated for three trophic levels in a grassland.
columns: Energy in new biomass (kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹)

question: Calculate the energy-transfer efficiency from producers to primary consumers and from primary to secondary consumers, then explain why energy availability decreases along the food chain.
markscheme: Producer-to-primary-consumer efficiency = 1500 ÷ 12500 × 100 = 12%.
Primary-to-secondary-consumer efficiency = 135 ÷ 1500 × 100 = 9%.
Not all biomass at one trophic level is consumed by the next level.
Some consumed material is not assimilated and is lost in feces or other waste.
Respiration transfers chemical energy to ATP and ultimately dissipates much of it as heat, so less energy is stored as biomass at higher trophic levels.
markschemeJa: 生産者から一次消費者への効率は1500÷12500×100=12%。
一次消費者から二次消費者への効率は135÷1500×100=9%。
ある栄養段階のバイオマスがすべて次の段階に食べられるわけではない。
食べられた物質の一部は同化されず、糞などの老廃物として失われる。
呼吸により化学エネルギーの多くが最終的に熱として散逸するため、高い栄養段階ほどバイオマスとして蓄えられるエネルギーが少なくなる。
modelAnswer: The producer-to-primary-consumer efficiency is 12%, and the primary-to-secondary-consumer efficiency is 9%. Energy decreases between trophic levels because not all biomass is eaten, not all ingested material is assimilated, and organisms use energy in respiration. Much of the energy used in metabolism is ultimately dissipated as heat rather than stored in new biomass.
modelAnswerJa: 生産者から一次消費者は12%、一次消費者から二次消費者は9%です。すべてのバイオマスが食べられるわけではなく、摂取した物質もすべて同化されません。また呼吸で使われたエネルギーの多くは熱として散逸するため、上位栄養段階へ移るエネルギーは減少します。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Effect of a ribosome inhibitor on protein production
stimulus.description: Identical cell cultures were exposed to increasing concentrations of a compound that binds to ribosomes. Newly synthesized protein was measured after one hour.
stimulus.note: Cell number was the same at the start of each treatment.

question: Analyse the data and explain how binding of the inhibitor to ribosomes could reduce protein production.
markscheme: Protein production decreases as inhibitor concentration increases.
At 8 µmol dm⁻³, protein production is only 8% of the untreated control.
Ribosomes are the sites of translation.
During translation, ribosomes read mRNA codons and coordinate tRNA binding and peptide formation.
Binding of the inhibitor can disrupt translation, reducing the rate at which amino acids are joined into polypeptides.
markschemeJa: 阻害剤濃度が上昇するほどタンパク質産生量は低下している。
8 µmol dm⁻³ではタンパク質産生量は無処理対照の8%にすぎない。
リボソームは翻訳が行われる場所である。
翻訳ではリボソームがmRNAコドンを読み、tRNAの結合やペプチド形成を調整する。
阻害剤がリボソームに結合すると翻訳が妨げられ、アミノ酸をポリペプチドへつなぐ速度が低下する。
modelAnswer: Protein production falls progressively as inhibitor concentration increases, reaching only 8% of control at the highest concentration. Ribosomes carry out translation by reading mRNA and coordinating tRNAs as amino acids are joined. A compound that interferes with ribosome function can therefore slow or stop translation and reduce new protein synthesis.
modelAnswerJa: 阻害剤濃度が高くなるほどタンパク質産生は低下し、最高濃度では対照の8%です。リボソームはmRNAを読み、tRNAを介してアミノ酸をつなぐ翻訳を行います。リボソーム機能が阻害されると翻訳が遅くなり、新しいタンパク質の合成量が減ります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Cell-cycle observations after drug treatment
stimulus.description: Root-tip cells were exposed to a drug that may inhibit mitosis. Cells were classified after six hours.
stimulus.note: One thousand cells were scored in each treatment.

question: Calculate the mitotic index for each treatment and evaluate the conclusion that the drug inhibits cell division.
markscheme: Control mitotic index = 240 ÷ 1000 = 0.24 or 24%.
Drug-treated mitotic index = 90 ÷ 1000 = 0.09 or 9%.
The lower mitotic index in the drug treatment is consistent with inhibition of mitosis or entry into mitosis.
The data support the conclusion because the same total number of cells was scored and the difference is large.
Repeated independent root tips and a measure of variation or statistical analysis would strengthen the conclusion.
markschemeJa: 対照の有糸分裂指数は240÷1000=0.24、つまり24%。
薬剤処理の有糸分裂指数は90÷1000=0.09、つまり9%。
薬剤処理で有糸分裂指数が低いことは、有糸分裂または有糸分裂への移行が阻害されたという考えと一致する。
同じ総細胞数を数えており差も大きいため、データは結論を支持する。
独立した複数の根端で反復し、ばらつきや統計解析を示すと結論がさらに強くなる。
modelAnswer: The mitotic index is 24% in the control and 9% after drug treatment. The substantial decrease is consistent with the drug inhibiting mitosis or preventing cells from entering mitosis. However, stronger evidence would come from independent biological replicates and a measure of variation or statistical significance.
modelAnswerJa: 有糸分裂指数は対照で24%、薬剤処理で9%です。大きな低下は薬剤が有糸分裂またはその開始を阻害するという結論を支持します。ただし、独立した反復とばらつき・統計解析があれば、より強い証拠になります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Relative hormone concentrations during a menstrual cycle
stimulus.description: Relative concentrations were measured at selected days of one cycle.
stimulus.note: Values are relative units, not absolute concentrations.

question: Using the data, deduce when ovulation most likely occurred and explain two hormonal changes associated with the cycle.
markscheme: Ovulation most likely occurred around day 14.
The very large LH peak at day 14 is the strongest evidence for the timing of ovulation.
Oestrogen rises before the LH surge and is high around day 14.
Progesterone is low before ovulation but rises strongly afterward, reaching a high value by day 20.
The later fall in progesterone is consistent with the end of the luteal phase when pregnancy has not occurred.
markschemeJa: 排卵は14日頃に起こった可能性が最も高い。
14日に非常に大きなLHピークがあることが排卵時期の最も強い証拠である。
エストロゲンはLHサージ前に上昇し、14日頃に高い。
プロゲステロンは排卵前は低いが、その後大きく増え、20日には高値となる。
その後のプロゲステロン低下は妊娠が成立しなかった場合の黄体期終了と一致する。
modelAnswer: Ovulation most likely occurred around day 14 because LH shows a sharp peak at that time. Oestrogen rises before this point and is high near day 14. Progesterone remains low before ovulation but increases markedly afterward, consistent with secretion by the corpus luteum during the luteal phase.
modelAnswerJa: 排卵はLHが急激に上昇している14日頃と考えられます。エストロゲンはその前から増え、14日付近で高値です。プロゲステロンは排卵前は低く、排卵後に大きく上昇しており、黄体期の変化と一致します。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Atmospheric CO₂ and regional climate indicators
stimulus.description: Long-term means were compiled for one region at five time points.
stimulus.note: Temperature anomaly is relative to a twentieth-century reference mean.

question: Evaluate the conclusion that increasing atmospheric CO₂ is associated with warming and ocean acidification. Include one limitation of these data.
markscheme: Atmospheric CO₂ increases across the data set from 339 ppm to 414 ppm.
The temperature anomaly increases over the same period, showing a positive association between CO₂ and warming.
Ocean surface pH decreases as CO₂ increases, consistent with increasing acidity.
The observations are consistent with known mechanisms by which greenhouse gases affect heat balance and dissolved CO₂ affects carbonate chemistry.
These observational data alone do not prove direct causation because other environmental variables also changed over time and only one region or set of measurements is represented.
markschemeJa: 大気中CO₂は339 ppmから414 ppmへ一貫して増加している。
同じ期間に気温偏差も上昇しており、CO₂と温暖化に正の関連がある。
CO₂が増えるにつれて海面pHは低下し、酸性化の進行と一致する。
この観察は温室効果ガスが熱収支に影響し、溶存CO₂が炭酸系に影響する既知の仕組みと一致する。
ただし観察データだけでは直接因果を証明できず、時間とともに他の環境要因も変化しており、1地域または限定された測定しか示していない。
modelAnswer: CO₂ increased from 339 to 414 ppm while the temperature anomaly rose from −0.10 to 0.61 °C, and ocean pH fell from 8.12 to 8.04. These trends are consistent with warming and ocean acidification occurring alongside rising CO₂. They also agree with known physical and chemical mechanisms. However, this observational series alone cannot establish that CO₂ was the only cause because other variables changed over the same period.
modelAnswerJa: CO₂は339から414 ppmへ増え、気温偏差は−0.10から0.61 °Cへ上昇し、海面pHは8.12から8.04へ低下しています。これらはCO₂増加と温暖化・海洋酸性化が同時に進むことを示し、既知の機構とも一致します。ただし観察データだけではCO₂が唯一の原因だとは証明できません。
